title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theater on 1985-10-28
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC/24 > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity w/dither > FLAC/16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) October 28, 2022

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording of a very good 10/28/1985 show with standout sound quality
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as the best‑sounding version of this concert, delivering clear and vibrant audio that likely comes from a matrix source. The performance itself is described as "very good," though it was reportedly eclipsed by the following night’s set.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews give an average of 4.33 stars, with strong praise for sound quality and a solid but not spectacular show assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners call it the best‑sound they've heard of this show; clear, crisp mix with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Show deemed "very good" but considered upstaged by the next night’s performance; no specific set‑list comments.
